problem_restatement: Determine whether the open V58 SP500 long failed to receive its configured completed-bar trailing exit evaluation, or whether the controller is active and correctly has no trigger.

root_cause_investigation.missing_completed_bar_behavior: emit profit_lock_candles poll_degraded, mark cycle degraded, and suppress the healthy heartbeat

covered_invariants: V58 index exit contract is exactly completed_bar_trailing 100/40/80.
Completed-bar trigger is persisted before a current-price close action is returned.
An untriggered path produces no close action.
Missing lifecycle bars fail closed and become observable.
A persisted trigger replays after restart and rejects invalid causal boundaries.
A profit-lock candle gap remains the latest health state and cannot be hidden by a heartbeat.

analysis: The current SP500 path never reached the configured 100-bps activation, so no trailing stop existed to trigger. The exact running controller source is pinned by the verified prestart bundle, is called on every live poll, and has an observable fail-closed candle-gap path. Fresh heartbeats with no profit-lock candle degradation support complete evaluation coverage. The evidence rejects a silent-controller-failure diagnosis for the observed path.
recommendation: Make no technical or live exit change for a nonexistent trigger. Continue the already-preregistered future-only 25/15/10, 40/15/20, and 60/15/30 challenger collection, and reconcile the current lifecycle only after its actual exit.

alternatives_considered.reason: The completed path did not satisfy activation and the execution path is verified active.
The current trade did not reach even the lowest predeclared 25-bps challenger, and changing from one open outcome would be post-hoc selection.
This retains causal attribution and tests lower activations under an already-frozen contract.

uncertainties_risks_and_failure_modes: No current-run SP500 path has yet activated the native 100-bps lock, so current-process trigger emission has not been observed directly.
Fresh heartbeats prove the configured candle-gap invariant only under the loaded implementation; a future code or profile change requires a new identity audit.
The native 100-bps activation may still be economically too high even though it is technically functioning.
The current open lifecycle can still stop or time out at a loss; that outcome would not by itself prove controller failure.
falsifiers_and_update_conditions: A completed current-run SP500 path exceeds 100 bps MFE, later crosses the derived completed-bar trailing stop, and produces neither a durable profit_lock_decision nor a close action.
A profit-lock candle gap occurs while a healthy heartbeat is still emitted for the same cycle.
The bound execution plan, prestart source identity, or current venue lifecycle differs from the audited values.
The future-only both-side challenger resolves with robust after-cost improvement, including largest-winner and execution-stress sensitivity.
